purpose: Final-layout candidate for approved Decision map identity; synthetic illustration, not implemented UI
prompt:
Create one high-fidelity desktop UI layout variation for the ALREADY CHOSEN TENET Decision map identity. This is a functional software comp, not a new branding proposal. Landscape 1536x1024, edge-to-edge app. Preserve this exact visual language: flat near-white #F5F5F2 canvas, carbon-black #171918 text and small circular nodes, ash-gray smooth curved connections, muted red #C53D36 ONLY for the failed evidence-confidence gate and its contribution to the policy result. Refined readable sans-serif, restrained monospace for the exact command and numbers, tiny connected-three-node emblem beside the bold TENET wordmark. No gradients, glow, grain, shadows, 3D, illustration, decorative linework, new colors, huge hero title, stacked analytics cards or marketing content.

This variation is 'Map + evidence'. The layout has a 75px top toolbar and 75px horizontal recent-call strip, then a diagram occupying the left 70% of the workspace, and a white evidence panel occupying the right 30%, separated by a single fine vertical rule. There is no left sidebar. Toolbar: TENET at left, 'tenet-observe', 'Read-only', 'Refresh archive' at right. Recent-call strip has selected 'Shell command / Would block' with a black underline; other items 'Edit file / Would allow', 'Edit file / Block', 'Shell command / Would allow'.

Left diagram: black circular terminal action node at x100 y450, branching smoothly to two assessment nodes around x480, with upper at y310 and lower at y590, then joining a black policy node at x880 y450. Small clear captions never crossed by connectors. Action caption 'Shell command'; below it the exact command broken into several readable short lines: 'git status --short && git diff -- README.md && git diff --cached --stat'. Upper assessment neutral outlined check: 'Rule outcome', 'PASS', 'Rule at line 5'. Lower assessment red outlined cross: 'Evidence confidence', '0.85', 'Below threshold'. Upper path gray, lower outgoing path RED, both feed the policy node captioned 'TENET decision', 'Would block'. Do not connect the assessment nodes to one another. The selected red confidence node has one discreet surrounding selection ring. This is a diagram of recorded gate contributions, never a claim to reveal model rationale.

Actual execution is separate from the graph in a quiet strip along the lower left: outlined check and 'Actual execution: Ran', followed by 'Observe mode does not enforce the decision.' No graph edge to execution. Far bottom-left status 'Synthetic preview data'.

Right evidence panel starts at x1090 beneath the call strip, padded 28px. Header 'Evidence confidence' and a small close icon. A short readable sentence 'This check contributed to the decision.' A prominent '0.85' and small label 'Recorded'; adjacent '0.9' labeled 'Required'. Below an exact linear meter on a gray track, fill to 85%, threshold at 90%, endpoints 0 and 1. Muted red fill, black threshold, no green success signal. Then 'Evidence confidence was below the required threshold.' A fine separator, then 'Rule at line 5', the exact sentence 'Never send any email without confirmation.', and 'Rule outcome: PASS'. Below it the important clarification 'PASS is not a reported violation.' The lower panel has four simple disclosure rows 'Submitted questions', 'Shared evidence', 'All rules', 'Recording details'. Do not invent actual submitted evidence text. The selected node and panel should feel spatially connected through alignment, not a glowing wire. Proposed motion is the selected node's red path drawing once and the panel opening from that selection; depict only the stable final state. Professional, coherent, quiet, highly visual, with sufficient actual font size to read everything. No new authorization controls or capabilities. One finished software screen.
reviewNotes: Restore small semantic glyphs in action and policy circles. Meter geometry must be exact. Do not replace the live data with this synthetic fixture.
